text:
name: routing_regret_under_degradation
question: >-
  Does a dynamics controller that escalates on measured confidence beat static
  cheapest / premium / quality-cascade policies in accepted-cost-per-outcome, once the
  four missing ledger fields (confidence, perturbation_strength, test_executed_success,
  answer/explanation split) are instrumented?
version: "0.2"
workflow:
  kind: story
  params: {stories: [task_manager_api, static_site_gen, notification_service]}
factors:
  - {name: model,     levels: [deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash, openai/gpt-5.6-luna, deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro, anthropic/claude-haiku-4-5, openai/gpt-5.6-terra, anthropic/claude-sonnet-5, openai/gpt-5.6-sol]}
  - {name: condition, levels: [clean, bad_seed, early_degrade, late_degrade]}
  - {name: policy,    levels: [cheapest, premium_static, quality_cascade, dynamics]}
design: factorial
rules:
  - {name: instrument_confidence,    plane: measurement, evidence_class: "[H]", requires: [], produces: [confidence]}
  - {name:…
